objective.name: point_count
constraints: each point is an integer pair (x,y) with 0 <= x,y < 100
for each three distinct points, all three squared side lengths are pairwise different, including degenerate collinear triples

highest_reported.source: Georgiev, Gomez-Serrano, Tao, Wagner, Mathematical exploration and discovery at scale, arXiv:2511.02864, Appendix 'Subsets of the grid with no isosceles triangles', construction sol_100.
highest_reported.reproduction_status: Coordinates extracted from the linked official AlphaEvolve problem notebook at repository commit 8f447457957deac61e28bf1676746f0753b3b2f8; independently validated with exact integer squared-distance checks. The task agents cannot reproduce the discovery process.

best_human.source: Odlyzko and Stanley, 'Some curious sequences constructed with the greedy algorithm', ternary no-three-term-arithmetic-progression construction; restricted to four ternary digits and embedded on one grid row.
best_human.evidence_state: Formula replayed and checked exactly. This is a weak human-method baseline, not a claim about the best human result.

best_public.source: AlphaEvolve construction reported in arXiv:2511.02864; source repository problem 59 and notebook.
best_public.evidence_state: Witness extracted from the pinned source revision and independently checked exactly.
best_public.ai_provenance: The construction is attributed to AlphaEvolve. The source paper reports human hints to the system. This is an AI-assisted result, not a human-only construction.

best_reproduced.verification_method: For each selected point, compute its exact squared distances to all other selected points and require these values to be distinct.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Reproduction confirms the witness and score. It does not establish discovery provenance.

compatibility_score.note: H is the weak, independently reconstructed classical human-method baseline.

optimality_status.status: open in sources reviewed; 164 is a lower bound, not a proof of optimality
optimality_status.source_statement: The AlphaEvolve paper says the 100 by 100 construction is believed not to be optimal.
optimality_status.review_scope: The cited paper, official problem page, and public source notebook/repository snapshot were checked. This is not an exhaustive literature search.

independent_quantity.method: Sort exact squared distances from each apex; every row must increase strictly.

other_public_result.evidence_state: Reported construction; not separately reproduced in this task.

traditional_search.evidence_state: Reproduced locally and exactly checked; not a public record.

T024-C01.source_review_scope: AlphaEvolve paper, official problem page, and linked source notebook at repository commit 8f447457957deac61e28bf1676746f0753b3b2f8; a 2026-10 public issue was checked for later n=100 claims.

best_human.evidence_state: Formula replayed and checker verified; weak baseline, not asserted to be the best human result.
